description: This file defines the VirtualInput class and related classes/interfaces for virtual input handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC communication for a plugin system.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for virtual input handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC communication.

classes.name: RepeatKeyTimer
classes.description: Handles timing for repeated key events.

classes.name: KeyMap
classes.description: Manages key code to key mapping, including import/export and pass-through mode.

classes.name: KeyMapEntry
classes.description: Represents a single key mapping entry with code, key, and modifiers.

classes.name: INotifier
classes.description: Interface for input event notification callbacks.

classes.name: PostLookupTable
classes.description: JSON container for key code conversion mappings.

classes.name: Conversion
classes.description: Represents a key code conversion pair.

classes.name: KeyCode
classes.description: Represents a key code and its modifiers for conversion.

classes.name: InputDataLink
classes.description: Handles IPC communication for input data, including subscription and key code translation.

classes.name: VirtualInputChannelServer
classes.description: IPC channel server for VirtualInput, managing client connections.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: Implements virtual input via IPC, allowing remote control of input events.

classes.name: InputHandler
classes.description: Manages initialization and deinitialization of input handling, supporting device and virtual modes.
